title: Villager Pickup
description: This Project adds the Capability to turn villagers into Spawn Eggs with Right clicking for easy Transportation, while keeping all the Trades etc.
body: # 🧑‍🌾 Villager Pickup Moving Villagers doesn't have to be a struggle. No more boats, minecarts, or frustrating pathfinding. **Villager Pickup** lets you pick up any Villager and move them with ease! Simply **Shift + Right-Click** a Villager to turn them into a Spawn Egg. --- ### ✨ Features * **📦 Easy Moving:** Pick up villagers and place them back down exactly where you want them. * **📜 Detailed Tooltips:** Hover over the Spawn Egg to see everything about your Villager: * **Profession & Level:** See their job and how high their level is. * **Workstation & Bed:** Shows the coordinates of where they are linked. * **Trade List:** View their trades directly in the item description. * **Enchanted Books:** If a Librarian has an Enchanted Book trade, it will show the **exact enchantment and level** (e.g., Mending I) right in the tooltip! * **🍦 Purely Server-Side:** This mod only needs to be on the server. Friends can join with a completely Vanilla Minecraft client! * **✅ Data-Safe:** Saves all trades, XP, and discounts. Nothing is lost when you pick them up. --- ### 🚀 How to Use 1. **Pick Up:** Crouch (Shift) and Right-Click a Villager with an empty hand. 2. **Move:** The Villager is now an item in your inventory. 3. **Place:** Use the Spawn Egg on the ground to put your Villager back. --- ### 📜 License Licensed under the **MIT License**. You are free to use this in any modpack!
